MOD = 1000000007

class Vec:
    def __init__(self):
        self.data = [0] * 30

class Mat:
    def __init__(self):
        self.mat = [[0] * 30 for _ in range(30)]

def getVal(num, base_k):
    if num < base_k:
        return num
    return (num + getVal(num // base_k, base_k)) % base_k

def multiply_matrices(a, b, base_k):
    res = Mat()
    for i in range(base_k):
        for j in range(base_k):
            res.mat[i][j] = 0
            for l in range(base_k):
                res.mat[i][j] += (a.mat[i][l] * b.mat[l][j]) % MOD
            res.mat[i][j] %= MOD
    return res

def multiply_matrix_vector(m, v, base_k):
    res = Vec()
    for i in range(base_k):
        res.data[i] = 0
        for j in range(base_k):
            res.data[i] += (v.data[j] * m.mat[i][j]) % MOD
        res.data[i] %= MOD
    return res

def precompute_matrices(total_n, base_k, matrices_arr, inv_matrices_arr):
    E_matrices = [[None for _ in range(base_k)] for _ in range(200)]
    EI_matrices = [[None for _ in range(base_k)] for _ in range(200)]
    for i in range(base_k):
        E_matrices[0][i] = matrices_arr[i]
        EI_matrices[0][i] = inv_matrices_arr[i]
    LOG = 0
    t = total_n
    while t > 0:
        LOG += 1
        t //= base_k
    for j in range(1, LOG + 1):
        for i in range(base_k):
            E_matrices[j][0] = E_matrices[j - 1][0]
            EI_matrices[j][0] = EI_matrices[j - 1][0]
        for l in range(1, base_k):
            E_matrices[j][0] = multiply_matrices(E_matrices[j - 1][l], E_matrices[j][0], base_k)
            EI_matrices[j][0] = multiply_matrices(EI_matrices[j][0], EI_matrices[j - 1][l], base_k)
        for i in range(1, base_k):
            E_matrices[j][i] = multiply_matrices(
                multiply_matrices(E_matrices[j - 1][i - 1], E_matrices[j][i - 1], base_k),
                EI_matrices[j - 1][i - 1], base_k
            )
            EI_matrices[j][i] = multiply_matrices(
                E_matrices[j - 1][i - 1],
                multiply_matrices(EI_matrices[j][i - 1], EI_matrices[j - 1][i - 1], base_k),
                base_k
            )
    return E_matrices, EI_matrices

def solve_vector(n, v, at, base_k, E_matrices):
    if n == 0:
        return v
    w = getVal(n // base_k, base_k)
    v = solve_vector(n // base_k, v, at + 1, base_k, E_matrices)
    for i in range(n % base_k):
        v = multiply_matrix_vector(E_matrices[at][(w + i) % base_k], v, base_k)
    return v

def main():
    total_n, base_k = map(int, input().split())
    matrices_arr = [Mat() for _ in range(base_k)]
    inv_matrices_arr = [Mat() for _ in range(base_k)]
    current_vec = Vec()
    for i in range(base_k):
        current_vec.data[i] = 1
        for j in range(base_k):
            for l in range(base_k):
                if j == l:
                    matrices_arr[i].mat[j][l] = 1
                    inv_matrices_arr[i].mat[j][l] = 1
                elif j == i:
                    matrices_arr[i].mat[j][l] = 1
                    inv_matrices_arr[i].mat[j][l] = -1
                else:
                    matrices_arr[i].mat[j][l] = 0
                    inv_matrices_arr[i].mat[j][l] = 0
    E_matrices, EI_matrices = precompute_matrices(total_n, base_k, matrices_arr, inv_matrices_arr)
    current_vec = solve_vector(total_n, current_vec, 0, base_k, E_matrices)
    total_sum = sum(current_vec.data[:base_k])
    total_sum -= 1
    total_sum %= MOD
    while total_sum % (base_k - 1) != 0:
        total_sum += MOD
    print(total_sum // (base_k - 1))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
